variants.text: Water through the roof in ten thousand places, and it has been doing it long enough to build the floor up to meet it.
The Weeping Vault. Columns of flowstone from floor to roof in a forest, and eleven of them are hollow.
The noise is continuous and it is the only noise, and it is not restful.
There is a square-cut shaft going up out of it, to the moor, and the rungs are rusted through at the top.
